item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00266","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C10","C22","C02"],"selected_candidate_label":"C10","confidence":0.97,"relationship_type":"structural_functional_template","rationale":"C10 plausibly supplied a concrete and material template. It asks Congress to establish a commission concerning the Executive Mansion, specifies the commission's role in addressing renovation and modernization, invokes prior congressional commission practice, and urges prompt enactment. The child adapts that same legislative-commission mechanism to the closely related problem of Presidential office space and expressly identifies the earlier Executive Mansion commission as complementary. C22 and C02 share study-and-recommendation commission machinery, but their targets and establishment by executive order make them less direct models.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I am submitting herewith for consideration of the Congress a draft bill \"To provide for the establishment of a President's Advisory Commission on Presidential Office Space.\"","parent_excerpt":"I consider it appropriate that the Congress should establish a Commission","explanation":"Both letters ask Congress to create a presidential-facilities commission through legislation."},{"child_excerpt":"This Commission will, in effect, complement the work of the earlier Commission for the Renovation of the Executive Mansion","parent_excerpt":"a Commission which would exercise general supervision and direction of all construction work involved in the renovation and modernization of the mansion","explanation":"The child expressly positions its proposed body as a successor or complement to the commission proposed in C10."},{"child_excerpt":"I strongly urge that this proposed legislation be acted upon before the close of the present session of Congress.","parent_excerpt":"I trust, therefore, that at the earliest possible date the Congress will enact legislation to establish a commission","explanation":"Both conclude by urging expedited congressional establishment of the commission."}]}
